description: This is a test source file for the litellm project that verifies whether numeric constants in the constants module can be overridden via environment variables. It imports necessary modules, inspects the constants module for uppercase numeric constants, and tests overriding these constants with environment variables using mocking and reloading.

methods.name: test_all_numeric_constants_can_be_overridden()
methods.description: Verifies that all numeric constants (integers and floats) in the constants module can be overridden by environment variables. It inspects the constants module for uppercase numeric constants, then for each, sets an environment variable with a different value, reloads the constants module, and asserts that the override was successful.
